newsitem.title: USA: Republic files to sell ADT shrs.
newsitem.headline: Republic files to sell ADT shrs.

text.p: ADT Ltd said it has filed a shelf registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Comission for the sale of its common stock on behalf of selling shareholders, including Republic Industries Inc.
Republic will be permitted to sell up to 15 million ADT shares, ADT said. Mourant & Co will be able to sell up to 86,698 shares, ADT said.

Republic's shares will be issued if it exercises a warrant that was issued in 1996 in connection with a proposed merger between ADT and Republic, ADT said. Republic and ADT scuttled their merger plans in September 1996, ADT said.
Western Resources Inc, a large shareholder of ADT is offering to buy the rest of the company.
Mourant & Co holds its shares in trust for Automated Security PLC employees which received ADT common shares in September 1996, when ADT acquired Automated Security.
ADT, a provider of electronic security services, will not receive any of the proceeds from the sale of these shares, it said.
